function.name: get_shopping_list
function.description: Read the person's shopping list: each item's id, name, quantity, unit and whether it is checked.

show.description: Which items to list; all of them when left out.

store.description: Only the items for this store, by its name; every store when left out.

ax.when: Pick this to see what is on the person's list, and to find an item's id before you remove it.

errors.means: The person has no shopping list yet.
errors.fix: Add an item with add_shopping_list_item, which starts the list.

function.name: add_shopping_list_item
function.description: Add one item to the person's shopping list. Give the name as the person said it; leave quantity and unit out when they gave none.

name.description: What to buy, as the person said it, such as "oat milk".

unit.description: The unit of the quantity, such as g, cups or cans.

idempotencyKey.description: Send the same key again when retrying this exact call, and the item is added once.

ax.when: Pick this to put one new thing the person asked for on their list; to take one off, use remove_shopping_list_item.

errors.means: The item's name is over 200 characters.
errors.fix: Send the item's name alone, and put any detail in quantity and unit.

function.name: remove_shopping_list_item
function.description: Remove one item from the person's shopping list by its id. Removing an item that is already gone changes nothing.

alsoIds.description: More item ids to remove in the same call.

ax.when: Pick this to take an item off the list once get_shopping_list has given you its id.

function.name: share_shopping_list
function.description: Share the person's shopping list with another person, who can then see and change it.

with.description: The email address of the person to share with.

canEdit.description: Whether they may change the list, not only see it.

message.description: A note to send with the invitation. It may run over several lines.

ax.when: Pick this only when the person asked to share their list with someone by email.

errors.means: No one in the person's household has that email address.
errors.fix: Ask the person for the email address of someone in their household.

ax.confirm: Share your list with this person? They will be able to see it and change it.

errors.means: Only the person can do this, so no agent may call it; the refusal says why and where the person does it.
errors.fix: Tell the person what the refusal says, and leave the step to them.

place_grocery_order.summary: Place order: You can't place an order or pay for the person; only they can. Ask the person, who does it with Place order on the shopping list.

error.problem: You can't place an order or pay for the person; only they can. Ask the person, who does it with Place order on the shopping list
error.message: Place order: You can't place an order or pay for the person; only they can. Ask the person, who does it with Place order on the shopping list.
